decisions: Carried forward, same environment: builds run with JAVA_HOME=/Users/ludwig/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-17.0.19/Contents/Home, because Maven defaults to Homebrew JDK 26 here and JaCoCo 0.8.12 cannot instrument class file major version 70.

Carried forward: scripts/check_api_baseline.sh exits 1 and revapi compares against an empty archive (v1.1.0 tagged, artifacts unreachable). Pre-existing, out of scope by the user's earlier explicit decision, excluded from done_when and recorded in the receipt.

One cycle is already fixed and is the template: route-odata-filter-audit-through-audit-core removed core <-> querydsl by moving ODataQueryExecutor, ODataSearch and ODataPage into a new execution package. The edge was removed by moving the type that pointed the wrong way, not by weakening anything.

1.1/1.2 TRACE: 20 violations (not 16 - execution and metadata, added since, widened the same family). ALL TWENTY start and end at `config`, and there is no cycle anywhere else. The inbound edges to config are exactly three - core, web and policy - and every one is an ODataFilterProperties import. Saved as cycles-before.txt.

D1 CONFIRMED by the trace and its rationale strengthened: the original 'renaming config gains nothing' was too weak. The real reason is that an auto-configuration class's FQN is configuration API - a deployment excludes one by name in YAML, which no compiler checks - so renaming the wiring package breaks an exclusion silently at runtime, while moving the properties class breaks a compile.

D2 WITHDRAWN: there is no core <-> validation <-> policy cycle. validation appears in four cycles and is a pass-through in every one; policy does not depend on core at all. Merging validation into policy would have been a restructuring performed for no reason, which is what taking the trace first was for.
2.1: moved ODataFilterProperties to ru.ludwigandreas.odatafilter.properties. One class, one boundary - all 20 cycles gone.

2.3 SECOND-ORDER FINDING, fixed properly: the move made spring.configuration-classes-reside-in-config-packages fail, because that rule's CONFIGURATION annotation role includes @ConfigurationProperties and accepts only ..config../..configuration... Fixed with the rule library's own mechanism - architecture.rules.conventions.packages.configuration.add = ..properties.. - which is exactly what file-ingest did for its ..autoconfigure.. wiring. Not a rename to fit the rule and not a suppression: a @Configuration class dropped anywhere else in this module is still a violation.

4.1: took D3's preferred option - hibernate-validator as an OPTIONAL dependency (version managed by spring-boot-dependencies, so ludwig-bom needed no entry), @Validated on ODataFilterProperties, @Min(1) on the five bound limits and @Valid on the three nested blocks. The springdoc jakarta.validation-api exclusion was REMOVED, because excluding the API while depending on an implementation that brings it would be self-contradictory.
4.2 the regression did not reopen: crud-service-example verifies green with 23/23 integration tests and no NoClassDefFoundError on ResourceBundleLocator.
